html:
Perks › Malus

Bone Anchor

Malus · Placement penalty

Your highest-pip bone is anchored whenever another play exists.

In-game card text

How it works

Malus. Your highest-pip bone can't be played while you have any other legal play. You can play it once it is your only option.

  • The rack recalculates every turn, so the anchored bone changes as you play.
  • Malus Ward does not affect it.
